Applying the switching map, γ˜1′′ = γ˜1′′(0,0) and γ˜2′′ = γ˜2′′(0,0) are approximately concatenations a1(0,0)♯b2(0,0), a2(0,0)♯b1(0,0) which are very close to two geodesics that intersect at an angle slightly less than π.
